text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Alert: Elevated 5xx and gateway timeout spike for /v1/generate across us-west-2 and eu-west-1. 5xx rate > 15% over last 3m, automated paging triggered. Alerts: 6/6

maya (oncall): i'm oncall, grabbing context. which services are flaring?

raj (sre): looks like api-gateway + inference-router cascades. first 429s at 16:02:11, then downstream 503/504 from runtime pools at 16:03:02.

sophie (infra): infra telemetry shows sudden saturation on rate-limiter service (rl-service) connections to redis shard-4. connection errors + high latency ~ 200-400ms.

maya (oncall): paging whole SRE + eng-runtime. tagging @tom.

tom (eng-runtime): seeing heavy prefix cache misses and a spike in cold KV cache fills. a lot of long-tail requests causing KV eviction and consequent downstream slow latencies -> timeouts.

kim (support): we have 3 active customer tickets reporting degraded responses and timeouts. CIDs: C-889, C-901, C-912. customers are seeing repeated 429 then 5xx.

leah (product): any customer-facing mitigation we can do quickly? status page update?

maya (oncall): will draft status msg once we have scope. can someone run `rl-service` health + config diff?

raj (sre): running quick diffs now. suspicious change deployed ~15:58 by deploy-bot: rate-limit policy rollout v2. Payload shows a global quota stack that accidentally aggregated tenant-level quotas into a single global bucket.

deploy-bot: deploy 2026-03-15T15:58:23Z by ci/cd: rolled rate-limit-config v2 -> prod (canary 100%).

tom (eng-runtime): that would explain the cascade. tenants suddenly hitting global quota -> 429 fanout -> client retries -> queue up -> backend threadpools saturated -> 5xx.

maya (oncall): rollback candidate? can we rollback that config to v1?

sophie (infra): yes. i can revert the config in rl-service. prepping rollback.

raj (sre): meanwhile, reduce retry aggressiveness at the API edge to limit amplification. patching gateway to backoff-on-429 for 30s. command: `kubectl apply -f gateway-backoff-30s.yaml`

tom (eng-runtime): i'm enabling a temporary per-tenant hard cap in inference-router to prevent single tenant from exhausting pooled capacity: `max_concurrent_per_tenant: 50` (applied to router-alpha).

kim (support): notifying affected customers with initial text: "We are investigating elevated errors causing timeouts and 429s. We're applying mitigations now; will update in 15m." :pray:

sophie (infra): rollback applied: rate-limit-config -> v1 @ 16:07:04. verifying metrics...

raj (sre): good: global 429 rates dropping immediately, but backlog of inflight requests still generating 503s. need token-bucket refill and decrease in concurrency to drain.

tom (eng-runtime): draining queues by temporarily raising worker preemption and shedding low-priority jobs. added fallback model route for best-effort requests to replacer-model-xx (lower compute) at 16:09:40.

maya (oncall): update on scope: currently ~12% of production traffic experienced elevated latency/5xx during 15:58-16:12 window. active customers impacted: C-889 (partial), C-912 (timeout heavy).

leah (product): estimate SLO blip and customer impact: likely sub-15m total; preparing status update.

raj (sre): root cause hypothesis: mis-deployed rate-limit configuration aggregated tenant quotas into a global bucket (human/CI config bug). cascade path: global 429 -> client retries -> worker saturation -> 5xx/timeouts.

tom (eng-runtime): attaching snippets of observed logs: ```
[16:02:58] router-alpha ERROR request_id=abc123 upstream=rl-service error=rate_limit_exceeded bucket=global
[16:03:05] runtime-pool WARN request_id=def456 queue_wait=420ms worker_timeout=500ms status=503
```

maya (oncall): mitigation checklist done: rollback config (sophie), gateway backoff (raj), per-tenant caps (tom), fallback model (tom), support comms (kim). any outstanding actions?

sophie (infra): I'll increase redis connection pool on rl-service and patch a monitoring alert to detect config rollouts that change aggregation keys.

raj (sre): file a deploy-blocker rule: PRs touching `rate-limit-config` must require two approvals and CI integration test that verifies tenant-level isolation.

leah (product): post-incident next steps: customer outreach to those 3 customers, update runbook with new checklist for rate-limit rollouts, and include traffic tests for aggressive retry scenarios.

kim (support): i'll follow up with the 3 customers and share timeline + workaround steps (e.g., client exponential backoff).

maya (oncall): removing paging after metrics stabilized at 16:14:30. leaving thread open for postmortem notes. :thumbsup:

tom (eng-runtime): we should also add a temporary automatic fallback: if downstream 5xx rate > 5% and upstream 429 rate > 2% for >2m, route new requests to degraded-mode (no-heavy-quantization) to maintain availability.

raj (sre): creating incident ticket INC-2026-311 with timeline + mitigation. assigning postmortem to tom + sophie.

leah (product): thank you all. proposed timeline for PM + infra review tomorrow 10:00 PST.

maya (oncall): final note: root cause = config aggregation bug in rate-limit rollout; impact window ~14m; mitigations rolled in ~6-11m; action items captured. closing thread but will append postmortem link when available. :white_check_mark:
